items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 21:1
items.html: Behold, the vessels of the face and the posterior of Nekudim include 320 sparks. From the aspect of the Chazeh and above they are the aspect of the first nine of each king of the eight kings that were broken, which are nine times thirty-two, in gematria 288; and from the aspect of the Chazeh and below, which are the aspect of the Malchuts of each discernment of the four discernments in the eight kings, which are thirty-two Malchuts — they are the thirty-two sparks that have no sorting before the completion of the correction. And had the vessels of the face and the posterior not been broken, and the vessels of the face not been mingled with the vessels of the posterior — that is, the 288 sparks with the 32 sparks, one in the other — there would be no correction at all to the vessels of the posterior, even at the completion of the correction. But through the mingling of the 288 with the 32, and their becoming included one in the other, until there is no small spark in the breaking that is not included from all the 320 sparks, then the aspects of the vessels of the posterior go on being sorted for ZON and for the Partzufim of BYA during the six thousand years, and through this, at the completion of the correction, also the aspects of the thirty-two of the stone are corrected. Hence, the descent of the 288 sparks and their mingling with the 32 sparks caused the revival of all the vessels of the eight kings, even to the aspect of their thirty-two of the stone. (Part 1, Page 953, subheading "but").
